logs.help: What the service writes, and its logs to read.
logs.writingHelp: Today's log, in the service's data folder.
logs.enabledHelp: Off, nothing is written to disk anymore.

resources.title: Resources
resources.help: This machine's disks and the shares that bring games.
resources.internalHelp: The disks mounted in the container, under /mnt. They bring games, sheets, patches, parameters, cores and BIOS.
resources.diskEmpty: No roms, bios, cores, patches, params or metadata.
resources.diskHelp: A disk is declared in the compose: it is mounted, not added here.
resources.rescanDiskHelp: Reads everything the disk holds again.

metadata.title: Metadata providers
metadata.help: The accounts that make the sheets of games that have none.
metadata.listHelp: A game on a disk that already has its sheet keeps it. For the others, the service makes the sheet with these accounts.

remoteAdmin.title: Remote administration
remoteAdmin.switchHelp: One of your administrators using this access also manages this server from theirs. Off, they can only play.
remoteAdmin.notAdmin: Your account does not administer this server from here. On that server, an administrator must allow remote administration in the access given to your server.
remoteAdmin.unreachable: This server opens no session for you: paste your account token from there first.
remoteAdmin.section: Shared with you as an admin
remoteAdmin.sectionHelp: Its settings, changed from here, on that server.
